work_items.title: Create controlled specification, work register, phased plan, and verification plan
work_items.scope: Create the project control documents and machine-checkable work register.
work_items.notes: Created from the 2026-11-10 request audit.

work_items.title: Complete and report the PUB mirror and index
work_items.scope: Confirm crawler completion, unresolved URLs, document counts, extraction counts, page index counts, and final archive health.
work_items.notes: The 2026-11-10 final run completed extraction, export, and audit. All previously named timeout gaps were recovered. The crawl has no pending or transient work, but complete_mirror remains false because 1,587 URLs returned permanent 404 responses, 79 IIS _notes paths have permanent redirect loops, and three optional sitemap or robots probes are absent.

work_items.title: Verify the NL Hydro uploads mirror
work_items.scope: Inventory and mirror dated public upload directories and record file, PDF, byte, and download counts.
work_items.notes: The mirror contains 2,539 files, including 2,521 PDFs. Research of the corpus remains separate work.

work_items.title: Create a direct Newfoundland Power regulatory inventory and mirror
work_items.scope: Inventory and preserve regulatory PDFs hosted directly by Newfoundland Power, including pages not mirrored by PUB.
work_items.notes: The 2026-11-11 inventory preserves all 13 PDFs linked from the official Regulation page. Ten have no byte-identical PUB hash.

work_items.title: Reconcile every current site claim with the source ledger
work_items.scope: Audit each displayed technical claim, diagram component, and value against its page-level source and evidence state.
work_items.notes: Static claim groups now have stable identifiers and page-level sources. Manual page-by-page transcription checks and final source-ledger reconciliation remain.

work_items.title: Search the direct and mirrored archives for current circuit and feeder registers
work_items.scope: Find a current replacement for the June 2005 circuit and feeder registers, or document that no public replacement was located.
work_items.notes: The final 504,049-page PUB index and the direct Newfoundland Power mirror were searched. No later complete public circuit or feeder register was located. The strongest later layers are the 2010 transmission construction register and the 2013 loading register; later capital records provide asset-specific changes only.

work_items.title: Preserve the original TOD Access database
work_items.scope: Acquire and hash the original ACCDB file, retain the exported table, and document row and recorder reconciliation.
work_items.notes: The preserved ACCDB was opened read-only through the 64-bit Access ODBC driver. Its single user table matches the export's 4,175,709 total rows, 4,175,472 measurements, 237 separator rows, 238 recorder IDs, 17,544 measurements per recorder, primary-key range, date range, and 304,371 zero-value rows. The maximum Access DOUBLE is 30966.601; the export stores 30966.60, so the third decimal place is not preserved. A full value-by-value comparison was not performed.

work_items.title: Find or document current one-lines for five Avalon substations
work_items.scope: Search for Glendale, Virginia Waters, Stamp's Lane, St. John's Main, and Pepperell bus and feeder arrangements.
work_items.notes: The 2026-11-11 archive search added station records for Glendale, Virginia Waters, Stamp's Lane, St. John's Main, and Pepperell. Current bus one-lines were not found; the evidence gaps are recorded in research/NP_STATION_GAP_LEDGER.md. The PUB audit continues independently.

work_items.title: Resolve feeder-to-transformer and bus-section assignments
work_items.scope: Find protection, operating, or one-line drawings that assign feeders to transformer banks and bus sections for detailed Avalon stations.
work_items.notes: CA-NP-255 establishes selected feeder-to-transformer assignments at HWD, OXP, KEN, GOU, KBR, RRD, SJM, SLA, PEP, and VIR. The 2013 Oxen Pond one-line assigns 70L, 32L, and 34L to B3; 67L, 58L, 35L, and 31L to B4; and identifies breaker B2B5 between the transformer-bus sections. The April 2013 East Coast restoration plan adds bank-level topology: HWD-T3 supplied HWD-07 and HWD-08 on the 25 kV bus; HWD-T1/T2 supplied one five-feeder 12.5 kV group; RRD-T2 and RRD-T3 each supplied four feeders on separate buses connected by RRD-TB-2-3. It also records the former dual-voltage King's Bridge feeder groups, three St. John's Main 12.5 kV groups and its 4.16 kV branch, and the Stamp's Lane 4.16 kV and 12.5 kV groups. CA-NP-158 closes Memorial's individual feeder assignments: MUN-07 to MUN-10 are on MUN-T2-B, MUN-01 to MUN-06 are on MUN-T1-B, and MUN-TB-1-2 ties the sections. It also assigns Long Pond circuits MUN-25 to MUN-29 to B1 and MUN-20 to MUN-24 to B2, while marking six of those circuits and T2 as future on the 2023 drawing. The 2027 register later lists LPD-T2 at 25 MVA. The March 2014 inspection forms identify dated breaker, transformer, recloser, regulator, and bus-tie assets for HWD, MOL, KEN, GOU, KBR, RRD, GDL, SJM, SLA, PEP, VIR, MUN, and OXP. Their condition fields are blank. The April 2019 Hardwoods form identifies its listed distribution, line and transformer breakers plus three feeder reclosers by asset and equipment type; HWD-T3 and HWD-73L-B are not on that later form. PUB-NP-064 Attachment F adds dated 2006 switchgear cubicle registers for KBR, RRD, PEP, SJM, and the SLA T1/T2 bank. Later rebuilds prevent treating those forms as current one-lines. The 2016 Virginia Waters record establishes four 66 kV circuits, three 25 MVA transformers, one 12.5 kV bus structure, eight distribution feeders, eight side-break switches, one bus-tie switch, and three transformer air-break switches, but not exact positions. The selected 2019 Pepperell study identifies VIR-01 and VIR-03 with VIR-T1/T2 in its proposed 2029 transfer. Its rejected Alternative 1 is not installed evidence. The 2021 planning-study update adds 2019-2020 actual, worst-case, and 2021 forecast peaks for BCV-T1, RRD-T2/T3 and VIR-T1/T2/T3. It also corrects an earlier VIR-T3 value that included a temporary February 22, 2019 transfer during a VIR-04 outage. Other exact current individual feeder-to-bus-section assignments remain deferred until operating or protection one-lines are located.

work_items.title: Locate missing feeder-map sheets
work_items.scope: Locate feeder maps beyond the preserved Hardwoods, Kenmount, Oxen Pond, Goulds, Glendale, St. John's Main, Stamp's Lane, King's Bridge, Pepperell, and Virginia Waters records.
work_items.notes: All 150 feeder sheets in CA-NP-020 Attachment B, physical PDF pp. 20 to 169, are extracted and connected to station records. The recovered first 38 sheets add Abrahams Cove through Garnish, including Bishop's Falls, Botwood, Bay Roberts, Chamberlains, Clarenville, Gambo, and Gander. The 2014 Electrical System Improvements filing separately supplies route and proposed-recloser drawings for HWD-08, KEN-01 to KEN-04, VIR-06, GOU-01, and GOU-03 on physical PDF pp. 36 to 44. CA-NP-020 does not contain feeder sheets for later additions including HWD-08, HWD-09, PEP-05, PUL-05, and VIR-07.

work_items.title: Resolve the Pulpit Rock secondary-voltage record
work_items.scope: Find the commissioning or as-built record that resolves 12.5 kV feeder statements against 25.0 kV operating-voltage records.
work_items.notes: The 2025 station narrative establishes five 12.5 kV feeders. The PUL-T2 asset and its replacement specification are dual-secondary 66/12.5/25 kV units. The 2027 portable-equipment table does not establish a feeder-bus conversion.

work_items.title: Create consistent Kenmount and Goulds one-lines
work_items.scope: Convert the supported Kenmount and Goulds station data into the same clickable one-line and evidence-panel pattern used by other detailed substations.
work_items.notes: Clickable simplified one-lines now show the documented logical connections, transformer ratings, voltage buses, circuits, and feeders. They do not add unsupported breaker or bus-section detail.

work_items.title: Expand detailed Avalon substation coverage
work_items.scope: Add consistent one-lines for every Avalon substation with sufficient public drawings, transformer data, and feeder data.
work_items.notes: Detailed sourced records now cover Cape Broyle, Fermeuse, Colliers, Springfield, Holyrood, Kenmount, Goulds, Glendale, Virginia Waters, Ridge Road, King's Bridge, Pepperrell, St. John's Main, and Stamp's Lane. The Stamp's Lane drawing separates the documented SLA-T1/T2 4.16 kV bank from the SLA-T3/T4 12.5 kV bank and shows only the nine feeders with filed voltage assignments. Breaker positions and unproved feeder assignments are omitted. The St. John's Main drawing is dated to the 2015 selected transformer addition and retains the historical 4.16 kV branch. The Virginia Waters drawing is dated to the 2016 station record. The Ridge Road drawing combines the documented 2015 split-bus arrangement with the later confirmation that its bus-tie breaker was installed. The King's Bridge drawing keeps the proposed 2028 T3 replacement separate from existing equipment. Pepperrell and Glendale show only documented logical topology. Springfield's 2015 modernization has a later completion record. Colliers and Holyrood remain labelled as application or proposed work pending direct completion evidence. Exact feeder-to-transformer and bus-section work continues under AVL-002.

work_items.title: Create a dedicated Molloy's Lane substation record
work_items.scope: Search the archive for Molloy's Lane station one-lines, transformer history, circuits, feeder voltages, and capital work, then replace the generic register-only view with a sourced station record.
work_items.notes: The dedicated record now uses the 2023 capital application for the station age, 15L and 19L supplies, transformer nameplates, customer count, 12.5 kV feeder count, and proposed refurbishment. The one-line is explicitly logical and omits bus sectionalizing. Six filed 2014 feeder route sheets are included.

work_items.title: Add the 2006 Avalon switchgear cubicle registers

work_items.notes: PUB-NP-064 Attachment F, physical PDF pp. 48, 57, 61, 65 and 66, contains the forms revised December 8, 2006 for King's Bridge, Pepperrell, Ridge Road, St. John's Main, and Stamp's Lane. The forms establish cubicle designations but not current bus positions.

work_items.title: Add dated Colliers and Springfield one-lines
work_items.scope: Combine the current circuit endpoint register, feeder register, transformer register, and separately dated modernization evidence into clickable station diagrams.
work_items.notes: The 2022 transmission asset register establishes 42L, 46L, and 47L endpoints. The diagrams use the 2018 feeder register and 2027 transformer table. Springfield has an explicit later completion record; Colliers breaker positions and direct completion remain open.

work_items.title: Make every documented circuit link open the other-end record
work_items.scope: Replace intermediate decorative-node navigation for TL208, TL203, TL237, and 66 kV circuit links when a destination record exists.
work_items.notes: TL203 and TL237 open the Sunnyside and Come By Chance terminal records. TL208 opens the Voisey's Bay Nickel terminal record; the 2013 GRA establishes that Long Harbour was removed from service and TL208 was extended in 2012. The 66 kV station links open the detailed diagram where one exists, otherwise they open the station record. Map-point selection remains in place and does not scroll the page.

work_items.title: Complete the full responsive visual audit
work_items.scope: Inspect every major section and detailed diagram at 390, 768, 1440, and 1920 px using the visual matrix.
work_items.notes: The 2026-11-11 browser audit covered every top-level section, station layout, framed diagram, station browser, and island-terminal browser at 390, 768, 1440, and 1920 px. No page or component overflow and no SVG text outside diagram bounds were found.

work_items.title: Create the structured island AC topology dataset
work_items.scope: Record documented 230 kV, 138 kV, 69 kV, and 66 kV lines, endpoints, source years, ownership, and page references.
work_items.notes: The tested 2018 assessment layer contains 58 Hydro circuit designations: 16 at 66 kV, 16 at 138 kV, and 26 at 230 kV. It records Hydro ownership, endpoints, source year, filed table, and physical PDF page. Nine circuit-specific historical 69 kV records remain separate from the 2018 filed values. Four generation collection circuits established by other Hydro records are stored in a separate layer under ISL-011. Post-2018 changes require a later dated layer, not an overwrite of this one.

work_items.title: Build the interactive island AC backbone
work_items.scope: Create a clickable dated island network from the structured topology dataset.
work_items.notes: The atlas renders every filed segment in the 58-circuit 2018 assessment layer plus four separately sourced generation collection circuits. Voltage filters, circuit selection, station selection, source-page links, keyboard operation, mobile horizontal scrolling, and links to existing station records are implemented. The 2012 source map remains above the interactive schematic.

work_items.title: Create detailed records and one-lines for major island terminals
work_items.scope: Expand Sunnyside, Stony Brook, Bay d'Espoir, Buchans, Deer Lake, Bottom Brook, Grand Falls, Massey Drive, Stephenville, and Come By Chance beyond summary cards.
work_items.notes: All ten records now include dated connection diagrams, circuit destinations, equipment data where stated, and page-level source links. Sunnyside follows the 2015 breaker-addition arrangement. Other records state the source year and omit unsupported breaker-level detail.

work_items.notes: Upper Salmon, Granite Canal, Cat Arm, and Hinds Lake have individual records with filed plant ratings, energy capability, and documented transmission connections. The separate generation collection layer establishes Cat Arm TL247 to Deer Lake, so the circuit now opens the Deer Lake record.

work_items.title: Add western and rural terminal-station coverage
work_items.scope: Add documented terminal and transformation records west and north of the current focus, proceeding east to west and then through the Northern Peninsula.
work_items.notes: Individual records cover the documented western, central, Northern Peninsula, Bonavista Peninsula, Burin Peninsula, southwest-coast, Southern Shore, and Avalon fringe stations located to date. The current pass added dated Abrahams Cove, Botwood, Carbonear, Gallant Street, Garnish, Heart's Content, Deer Lake, Bay Roberts, Bayview, Big Pond, Bishop's Falls, Cobb's Pond, Gander, Jonathan's Pond, Roycefield Tap, Notre Dame Junction, Glenwood, Cape Broyle, Fermeuse, Broad Cove, Chamberlains, Sunnyside, Massey Drive, Stephenville, Bottom Brook, Wheelers, Alexander Bay, Indian Cove, St. John's Diesel, and Argentia records. Botwood includes the 2005 BOT-01 engineering study, its filed route sheet, and the separately documented 2008 completion of work on feeder sections. Grand Falls distinguishes the NGF 138/66/25 kV yard from the separate GFS 66/4.16 kV yard, records the 2011 to 2016 NGF work, and now has a logical one-line through the current 4.2 kV bank. Deer Lake separates the completed 2010 transformer replacement, the 2018 and 2027 low-voltage records, and the approved 2026 to 2027 DLK-03 work. Bay Roberts separates its filed station arrangement, 2014 modernization and BRB-T4 proposals, the reported 2014/15 transformer arrangement, and the 2020 BRB-05 proposal. Bayview now includes the completed 2004 BVS-T2 relocation, five feeders, current transformer and circuit records, proposed modernization, and the filed BVS-04 and BVS-05 route drawings. Big Pond now includes its 17L and 24L connections, current customer and water-supply record, filed cooling addition, reported load, and proposed 24L rebuild. Abrahams Cove now has both 410L sections, the current customer and contingency record, and the Lower Cove customer-funding boundary. Garnish now records the proposed replacement and the completed 2009 relocation from a 1.6 km tap to a direct 301L connection without a high-voltage bus. Bishop's Falls now has its 1978 steel 138/25 kV structures, current 132L, 133L, 134L, and 136L endpoints, March 2014 equipment register, Grand Falls tie alternative, and the 2036 P90 136L contingency result. Cobb's Pond now has the current TL210, 142L, 144L, and 147L connections, a three-bus diagram, dated structure history, 2012 COB-T3 addition, 2014 equipment register, and 2025 COB-T3 failure and repair. Gander now separates the existing 16/21.3/26.67 MVA GAN-T2 from its approved 41.6 MVA replacement, records the 2010 measured load and 2014 breaker inventory, and dates the approved 2027 transfer of the 66 kV supply function to Boyd's Cove. Notre Dame Junction is retained as a historical 66 kV switching record because the located order approved conditional removal but did not certify completion. Cape Broyle and Fermeuse now have sourced logical one-lines, transformer and feeder records, completed 2008 project records, 2014 equipment registers, and the wind-interconnection ownership boundary. Chamberlains now records the 2003 second-bank proposal, the filed 2017 T1 and CHA-04 work, current transformer values, and the 2027 CHA-04 route and upgrade. Broad Cove keeps the 2021 66/12.5 kV station arrangement separate from the 2027 66/25 kV fleet entry, and does not draw the proposed BCV-T2 as installed. Sunnyside now joins the 230/138 kV Hydro terminal, the 138/25 kV SUN-T5 bank, SUN-01, SUN-03, current transformer value, and March 2014 distribution equipment register in one dated profile. Stephenville now separates its retained gas-turbine equipment from the partially completed retirement project, the 2024 planning assumption, the 2025 transformer and relay work, and the 2026 life-extension assessment. Bottom Brook now separates the commissioned Terminal Station 2 ring bus and retained T1, T2, and T3 from the proposed T4 and the cancelled remainder of the Stephenville-retirement work. Wheelers is now represented as a 66 kV switching point between 400L and the 404L tap into 401L, with the 2004 decommissioning proposal, 2014 operating state, and 2015 to 2016 filed rebuild kept separate. Argentia is retained as a dated historical 55L endpoint; the present arrangement remains unresolved. The handbook reconciliation leaves only Baie Verte Mines and Musgrave Harbour without dedicated diagrams because no electrical arrangement was located. Current breaker drawings and unsupported equipment details remain open where no filing has been located.

work_items.title: Complete island transformer nameplate and age records
work_items.scope: Record transformer designations, winding voltages, cooling ratings, impedances, manufacturers, manufacture dates, in-service dates, and replacements where published.
work_items.notes: The evidence pass added dated Howley, Deer Lake, Stony Brook, Massey Drive, Sunnyside, Holyrood, Buchans, Bay d'Espoir, and Come By Chance transformer records. Holyrood T7 and T8 replacement histories extend through the 2024 T7 commissioning completion. Bay d'Espoir has separate 1998 station 1 and 2013 station 2 equipment records, GSU manufacture years, the T5S and T6S repair and spare history, the approved 2025 common-spare budget and schedule, and the 2023 Unit 7 generator, excitation-transformer, and neutral-grounding records tied to Order P.U. 12(2026). The proposed Unit 8 record adds the filed Francis turbine, synchronous generator, static excitation, 129/172 MVA GSU design, two early-work orders totaling $22.300 million, and the October 2026 procurement status without drawing Unit 8 as installed. The Come By Chance record includes the 2014 ratings, manufacture dates, bus arrangement, and the later Braya-specific cost assignment. Nameplate, filed equipment, study-model, and emergency ratings remain separate. Unsupported rural nameplates and current rural one-lines remain deferred under ISL-005.

The load section adds the filed 2006 to 2010 EMS peak series without treating the values as circuit ratings.

work_items.title: Add central and western 230 kV circuit engineering records

work_items.notes: The circuit panels now include dated records for TL204, TL231, TL205, TL232, TL228, TL233, TL211, and TL209. The 2015 planning table and 2016 reliability base case remain separate. work_items.title: Add Bay d'Espoir and Granite Canal generation collection records

work_items.title: Add omitted generation collection circuits to the island schematic
work_items.scope: Add TL235, TL247, TL248, and TL269 from their own Hydro filings without changing the scope of the 58-circuit PUB-NP-084 assessment asset list.
work_items.notes: The generation collection layer adds four circuits outside the 58-circuit assessment asset list. TL235 carries the 2015 load and 2016 route records and opens a dedicated Grand Falls Frequency Converter record. TL247 and TL248 carry the Deer Lake connection history, steel-line ratings, planning loads, and route lengths. Cat Arm TL247 links to Deer Lake. TL269 separates the 2016 post-HVDC model from the 2017 reported in-service state.

work_items.title: Add the complete 2015 138 kV and 66/69 kV planning-load tables
work_items.scope: Attach every filed 138 kV and 66/69 kV rating, anticipated winter peak, anticipated average load, filed average-to-peak percentage, and circuit-specific operating note in PUB-NLH-324 to its dated circuit record.
work_items.notes: The source-specific layer contains all 16 rows from the 138 kV table and all 16 rows from the 66/69 kV table. It keeps the 2015 source voltage label separate from the later 2018 circuit voltage and preserves the filing's generation, reactor, capacitor, line-charging, mine-closure, and production-dependent loading notes.

work_items.title: Add TL225 and TL257 as supplemental island AC circuits
work_items.scope: Add the two circuits in the 2015 planning-load tables that are absent from the PUB-NP-084 assessment asset list, using separate endpoint and voltage records.
work_items.notes: TL225 is rendered as the filed 66 kV Deer Lake Power to Deer Lake circuit. TL257 is rendered as the filed 69 kV St. Anthony Airport to Roddickton Woodchip circuit with its 1989 construction record. Both receive their 2015 rating and load records without changing the 58-circuit assessment asset list.

work_items.title: Attach the Great Northern Peninsula circuit construction history
work_items.scope: Attach the filed construction, reconfiguration, and voltage history for TL221, TL241, TL244, TL256, TL261, and TL257 without replacing the later topology inventory.
work_items.notes: IC-270 physical PDF pp. 34 to 35 establish the 1970 TL221 build, the 1990 Peter's Barren reconfiguration and TL262 renumbering, the 1983 and 1995 TL241 and TL244 histories, the 1995 TL256 build, the 1996 TL261 build, and the 1989 TL257 build. The dated 69 kV TL261 construction record remains separate from the 2018 66 kV topology listing.

work_items.title: Add the Deer Lake Power generating-station interface
work_items.scope: Add a dedicated Deer Lake Power record that separates the 60 Hz generating group, L1, TL225, and the Corner Brook frequency converter.
work_items.notes: The station record uses the 2013 system one-line, the 2017 generation supply table, the 2018 industrial-customer asset review, and PUB-NLH-309. It shows DLPG1-7 at the filed 81.1 MW combined rating, L1 to Massey Drive, and TL225 to Deer Lake. The 18.0 MW frequency-converter entry remains separate. Generator-by-generator ratings and a current plant switchgear one-line were not located.

work_items.title: Add Great Northern Peninsula backup and historic generation records
work_items.scope: Connect the St. Anthony backup plant and retired Roddickton generation sites to their filed capacities, circuit interfaces, and dated disposition records.
work_items.notes: IC-270 physical PDF pp. 3 to 4 establish the pre-interconnection generating capacities and the TL257 and TL261 line records. Order P.U. 34 (2004) physical PDF pp. 1 and 11 records the Roddickton plant abandonments and relocation of two 850 kW mobile units to St. Anthony. The 2024 Annual Planning Assessment physical PDF p. 42 provides the current filed 9.7 MW St. Anthony backup capacity.

work_items.title: Add Avalon terminal asset in-service dates from the 2026 GRA
work_items.scope: Add exact in-service dates for named Holyrood and Western Avalon terminal assets without inferring a bus arrangement from the financial asset schedule.
work_items.notes: IIC-NLH-012 Attachment 2 records the replacement Holyrood T7 in service on February 1, 2024; Western Avalon TL208 protection and disconnect L08G in service on November 4, 2017; the TL208 cable and terminal-hardware group in service on December 15, 2018; and breaker B4L64 in service on November 5, 2020. The asset schedule does not establish internal bus positions.

work_items.title: Add the Central Newfoundland program closeout
work_items.scope: Add the reported completion and actual expenditure for the 2019 to 2021 Central Newfoundland 138 kV conversion program without assigning an unsupported Notre Dame Junction removal date.

The program-level closeout does not give a Notre Dame Junction dismantling date, so that station remains a historical arrangement rather than a dated removal record.

work_items.title: Replace the Bay d'Espoir interface sketch with the filed generating-station arrangement
work_items.scope: Use the 1998 Station 1 and 2013 Station 2 operating diagrams to separate the seven generator terminals, generator step-up transformers, Station 2 transformation, and outgoing circuits.

work_items.scope: Use the filed 2016 operating diagram to replace the connection sketch with the B2 and B1 bus sections, normally closed B1B2 disconnect, B1 ring section, transformer positions, breaker identifiers, and five documented 230 kV circuits.
work_items.notes: The 2016 risk and reward review, physical PDF pp. 34 and 42, establishes T2 on B2, T1 on B1, normally closed disconnect B1B2, line breakers B2L04 and B1L32, and the B1L31, L05L31, L05L35 and B1L35 ring section serving TL231, TL205 and TL235. The proposed dedicated transformer breakers remain excluded from the installed arrangement because the same study did not recommend the additions.

work_items.scope: Replace the connection sketch with the named T2 and T1 transformer stages, the filed B3L47 and B3L48 230 kV terminals, the filed B2L26 and B2L25 66 kV terminals, and all six documented transmission routes without inventing the missing 138 kV breaker arrangement.
work_items.notes: The 2014 operating diagram, physical PDF pp. 769 to 770, establishes bus B2, breakers B2L26 and B2L25, TL226 and TL225, and the L25-2 isolation point. The 2016 transformer-protection study, physical PDF p. 19, identifies T2 with B3L47 and B3L48 on TL247 and TL248. The 2003 report supplies staged transformer ratings. No filed breaker-level drawing for the 138 kV section was found in this pass.

work_items.title: Reconstruct the Buchans five-breaker ring bus
work_items.scope: Replace the four-line connection sketch with the filed five-breaker ring around T1, its four 230 kV line positions, the named 66 kV line breakers, and the completed T1 replacement record.
work_items.notes: The January 2013 storm report, physical PDF pp. 135 and 150 to 151, identifies T1 operation through B1L05 and B1L28 and the L05L33 and L32L33 line positions. Undertaking 73, physical PDF p. 3, lists the air-blast breakers B1L05, L05L33, L28L32 and B1L28. The 2017 transformer-protection study, physical PDF p. 9, confirms T1 already had two-breaker protection. The 2018 industrial-customer asset review identifies TL264 through B2L64; the 2013 restoration record identifies B2L80.

work_items.title: Reconstruct the Massey Drive split buses and customer interface
work_items.scope: Replace the transformer connection sketch with the filed B1 and B5 230 kV sections, the three named line breakers, the B4 customer bus, the B2 and B3 Newfoundland Power sections, both bus ties, the transformer low-side breakers, and all documented outgoing circuits.
work_items.notes: The 2017 terminal-risk review, physical PDF p. 28, establishes T1 on B1, T2 and T3 on B5, normally closed disconnect B1B5, and breakers B1L48, B1L28 and B5L11. The January 2013 event report establishes low-side breakers B4T1, B2T2 and B3T3. The 2018 industrial-customer report assigns L1, L16 and L17 to B4. The 2017 disconnect register assigns 352L and 356L to B2 and 351L and 357L to B3. CA-NLH-085 establishes that B2B4-1 is closed when supplemental capacity assistance is requested.

work_items.title: Reconstruct the Stephenville circuit switcher and 66 kV ring
work_items.scope: Replace the connection sketch with the filed B1L09 circuit switcher, direct-connected T3 position, three-breaker 66 kV ring, gas-turbine transformer and generator, and the documented Newfoundland Power circuits without restoring the retired Abitibi mill branch to the live diagram.
work_items.notes: The 2018 operating drawing in the 2021 Capital Budget Application, physical PDF p. 511, establishes circuit switcher B1L09, direct-connected T3, and the retained gas-turbine equipment. The proposed-removal drawing on physical PDF p. 521 identifies the existing 66 kV ring breakers L405T4, B2T3, and B2L405. The 2017 terminal-risk review, physical PDF p. 32, confirms that T3 lacked an individual 230 kV breaker. IC-NLH-101, physical PDF pp. 2 to 3, records L09L38, its disconnects, and TL238 as removed from service after the former mill closed.

work_items.title: Reconstruct the Bottom Brook terminal stations
work_items.scope: Separate Terminal Station 2 from Terminal Station 1, then replace the combined connection sketch with the filed four-diameter, 12-breaker 230 kV breaker-and-one-half yard and the installed 230/138/66 kV transformer and line-breaker arrangement.
work_items.notes: CA-NLH-036, physical PDF p. 2, states that the rebuilt Terminal Station 2 uses breaker-and-one-half configuration, with TL209, TL211, TL233, TL269, T1, T3, and both converter connections on separate legs. NP-NLH-001, physical PDF pp. 3 and 5, identifies the twelve installed breaker positions, the eight circuit and transformer taps, the B2/B3 normally open 138 kV tie, B2L14, B3L50, and B6L400. Proposed T4 equipment is omitted from the installed diagrams.

work_items.title: Reconstruct the Deer Lake 138 kV ring bus
work_items.scope: Replace the unresolved Deer Lake 138 kV section with the filed four-breaker ring, the TL239 and TL245 positions, and the T2 ring connection while retaining the documented 230 kV and 66 kV equipment.
work_items.notes: PUB-NLH-318, physical PDF p. 4, states that the 138 kV ring bus was established in 1983 to 1984. The 2015 breaker report, physical PDF pp. 37 to 38, names B1L39, L39T2, L45T2, and B1L45. The January 2013 event report, physical PDF p. 191, records TL239 tripping through L39T2 and B1L39. The breaker names and filed ring-bus history establish the B1, TL239, T2, and TL245 ring positions.

work_items.title: Add the Grand Falls and Bishop's Falls breaker registers
work_items.scope: Add the filed March 2014 line, transformer, and feeder breaker identifiers to the Grand Falls and Bishop's Falls logical one-lines without presenting the dated inspection register as a current as-built drawing.
work_items.notes: PUB-NP-064 Attachment G identifies GFS-130L-B, GFS-132L-B, GFS-T1-B, GFS-T2-B, GFS-T3-B, GFS-T5-B, and five GFS feeder breakers on physical PDF pp. 178 and 332 to 337. Physical PDF pp. 28 to 31 identify BFS-132L-B, BFS-133L-B, BFS-134L-B, and BFS-136L-B. No located filing establishes the present bus-section and disconnect-switch arrangement, so that drawing target remains open.

work_items.title: Reconstruct the filed Soldiers Pond 230 kV yard
work_items.scope: Replace the simplified Soldiers Pond interface with the filed B1/B2 breaker strings and add published filter and transformer-spare data without treating the 2015 drawing as a post-commissioning as-built.
work_items.notes: NP-NLH-013, physical PDF pp. 1 to 2, provides the September 2015 B1/B2 operating diagram with five breaker strings, 18 breaker identifiers, six 230 kV line positions, three synchronous-condenser connections, and four converter-station connections. PUB-NLH-630, physical PDF p. 8, records five 75 MVAR operating filters plus one installed spare. CA-NLH-019, physical PDF p. 36, lists the 230/25/15 kV, 200 MVA synchronous-condenser transformer spare and a converter-transformer spare at Soldiers Pond. Converter-transformer nameplates, station service, and a post-commissioning as-built breaker sheet remain open.

work_items.title: Trace the Holyrood 230 kV breaker replacement program
work_items.scope: Connect the filed nine-breaker schedule to the available 2014, 2015 and 2016 completion records without presenting the historical Holyrood one-line as a current as-built arrangement.
work_items.notes: The August 2014 program assigns B2B11, B1B11 and B1L17 to 2014; B2L42, B3L18 and B3B13 to 2015; and B12L42, B12L17 and B12B15 to 2016. NP-NLH-131 Revision 1 explicitly records the 2014 group as replaced. PR-PUB-NLH-036 records B1L17 in service on October 17, 2014. The December 2015 report states that the Holyrood breaker upgrades were complete and in service. The 2016 report marks the wider Upgrade Circuit Breakers 2015-2016 program complete, but does not list its Holyrood breakers or their individual commissioning dates.

work_items.title: Add the dated Hardwoods and Western Avalon operating arrangements
work_items.scope: Replace the simplified Hardwoods and proposed Western Avalon sketches with the filed dated bus sections, bus ties, transformer positions, and documented lower-voltage circuits without presenting the historical drawings as current as-builts.
work_items.notes: HWD-1 revision 17, dated July 7, 1991, establishes the B1/B2 230 kV sections, B7/B8 66 kV sections, B1B2 and B7B8 ties, transformer positions, capacitor banks, station service, and generator branch. WAV-A revision 6 and WAV-B revision 15, dated April 29, 2010 and June 12, 2012, establish the Western Avalon B3/B1, B4, and B2 sections, B1B3 tie, T1 through T6, 64L, 86L, and three 12.5 kV feeders. The 2026 Hardwoods condition-study register names HWD-1 revision 38, dated October 11, 2019, but does not reproduce it.

work_items.title: Add completed 2025 terminal-station equipment work
work_items.scope: Use Hydro's quarterly financial and work-plan reports to add completed transformer, breaker, disconnect, relay, monitoring, and coating work to the affected station records.
work_items.notes: The Q1 through Q4 2025 summaries establish completed work at Oxen Pond, Hardwoods, Holyrood, Sunnyside, Stony Brook, Western Avalon, Bay d'Espoir, Upper Salmon, Massey Drive, Come By Chance, Grand Falls Frequency Converter, Stephenville, and Buchans. The atlas records exact equipment identifiers where the filing provides them.

work_items.title: Reconcile completed 2024 terminal-station work
work_items.scope: Reconcile Hydro's 2024 quarterly and year-end completion reports with the proposed capital-program asset registers without converting planned equipment into as-built facts.
work_items.notes: The Q1 through Q4 summaries establish completed station work. Exact equipment identifiers are used only when the report names the asset or another filing supplies a unique mapping. Hardwoods B2L42 current-transformer construction did not proceed in 2024 or 2025 and remains separate from completed work.

work_items.title: Add the December 2022 Newfoundland Power transmission asset register
work_items.scope: Extract CA-NP-168 Attachment A and present its 109 transmission asset rows as a dated register separate from the June 2005 handbook network.
work_items.notes: CA-NP-168 physical PDF pp. 1 and 3 to 4 provide 109 unique circuit records. The parsed circuit costs total $186,897,000; with $54,000 undistributed, this reconciles to the published $186,951,000 total. The source states a December 31, 2022 historical-cost date and does not establish voltage, conductor, length, breaker positions, or present energization.

work_items.title: Add the PUB-NP-081 distribution feeder register
work_items.scope: Extract the complete 300-row feeder table and present its operating-voltage and 2024 to 2025 planning values as a dated register.
work_items.notes: PUB-NP-081 Attachment B physical PDF pp. 10 to 20 contains 108 St. John's, 87 Eastern, and 105 Western feeder rows. All 300 published loading percentages reconcile to forecast winter peak divided by planning capacity within 0.02 percentage point. The values are planning forecasts, not measured peaks.

work_items.title: Add the completed 24L shoreline relocation record
work_items.scope: Connect the filed 1.6 km 24L shoreline relocation, protected-water-supply construction constraints, BIG-02 underbuild, and the reported completion to the Big Pond and Mobile station histories.
work_items.notes: The 2024 filing records the 1.6 km shoreline relocation and BIG-02 work. NLH-NP-025 confirms 66 kV, steel poles, the protected-water-supply constraint, and BIG-02 underbuild. The Q2 2026 report records the relocation complete for the quarter ended June 30, 2026; no exact commissioning date was found.

work_items.title: Reconcile Newfoundland Power 2024 station and feeder closeouts
work_items.scope: Reconcile quarterly completion reports, the annual capital expenditure report, and the annual financial report without treating equipment commissioning and financial closeout as the same event.
work_items.notes: The Q3 report records the Oxen Pond 66 kV bus upgrade and switch replacements complete. The annual capital report records zero carryover for those projects and the OXP-01 refurbishment. Gambo and Old Perlican were commissioned in 2024, while final capital expenditures carried into 2025. The annual financial report was checked and did not add station topology or equipment ratings.

work_items.title: Reconcile Newfoundland Power 2023 feeder, station, and telecommunications closeouts
work_items.scope: Reconcile the 2023 capital application, quarterly completion reports, capital expenditure report, and annual report for Pulpit Rock feeder work, the Corner Brook hospital supply, station work, transmission rebuilds, and teleprotection commissioning.
work_items.notes: The PUL-01 and PUL-04 load-growth projects and the BVS-03 hospital redundant supply are tied to their filed routes, reported completion, and final expenditure. The Q4 report also records 24 St. John's area transmission lines migrated to the commissioned replacement teleprotection system. Later filings remain controlling for the final 55L and 94L corridor scope.

work_items.title: Reconcile Newfoundland Power 2022 station, feeder, outage, and capital closeouts
work_items.scope: Reconcile the 2022 capital application, Q4 completion report, capital expenditure report, and annual report for completed station work, feeder projects, outage events, and year-end financial closeout.
work_items.notes: Humber, Glovertown, and SPF-01 are tied to direct completion records. Humber also has a separate project closeout. Broad Cove retains the reported November 22 radial-supply outage without assigning an unreported circuit number. The 2022 teleprotection carryover remains separate from its 2023 commissioning record.

work_items.title: Reconcile Newfoundland Power 2021 feeder, station, transmission, and capital records
work_items.scope: Reconcile the 2021 capital application, capital expenditure report, and annual financial report for feeder projects, station work, transmission projects, equipment failures, and year-end carryover.
work_items.notes: The filed RRD-10, SPF-02, PUL-05, and CHA-04 scopes and route drawings are attached to their station records. The expenditure report leaves $671,000 of the load-growth feeder program in 2022 carryover without identifying an individual feeder, so the asset records remain proposed. The annual report adds aggregate plant values but no topology or commissioning dates.

work_items.title: Reconcile Newfoundland Power 2020 feeder, station, transmission, and capital records
work_items.scope: Reconcile the 2020 capital application, capital expenditure report, later completion responses, route drawings, and year-end carryover for feeder projects and station modernization.
work_items.notes: CA-NP-113 ties Bonavista, Marystown, and Grand Bay modernization to 2020 substantial completion and station-level capital spend. The filed BRB-05, OXP-01, PUL-05, BCV-03, and GDL-09 scopes and route drawings are attached to their station records. CA-NP-176 identifies GDL-09 as completed in 2021. The 2020 expenditure report does not allocate the remaining feeder-program spend or carryover by asset, so BRB-05, OXP-01, PUL-05, and BCV-03 remain proposed.

work_items.title: Reconcile Newfoundland Power 2019 feeder, transmission, telecommunications, and capital records
work_items.scope: Reconcile the 2018 and 2019 capital applications, route drawings, the 2019 capital expenditure report, and the Long Pond project records.
work_items.notes: The filed BLK-02, DUN-01, SJM-06, SCV-01, and SLA-05 scopes and route drawings are attached to their station records. The expenditure report supplies actual Long Pond, Oxen Pond termination, and 36L spending and the 36L construction explanation. The report's Long Pond p. 20 value conflicts with its own variance and the p. 8 category table; the reconciled $2.382 million value is documented. Asset-level completion remains open for four feeder projects and the filed Humber to Bayview fibre link.

work_items.title: Reconcile Newfoundland Power 2018 transmission, feeder, automation, and capital records
work_items.scope: Reconcile the 2018 capital application, line and feeder drawings, the 2018 capital expenditure report, later 302L completion records, and the two separate feeder-automation programs.
work_items.notes: The 302L record now combines the filed Salt Pond to Laurentian rebuild, route sheet, later complete status, and annual actual costs. BCV-03, KEN-03, SUM-02, and TRP-01 retain filed asset details without treating pooled financial closeout as commissioning evidence. The station automation and downline recloser programs remain separate. The filing's nine named downline feeders and eight-recloser program statement are both preserved.

work_items.title: Reconcile Newfoundland Power 2017 transmission, feeder, automation, and capital records
work_items.scope: Reconcile the 2017 capital application, line and feeder route drawings, feeder-automation records, and later reported project expenditures.
work_items.notes: The station records now include the filed 32L, 41L, 57L, and RBK-01 work, four original route drawings, and the eight named downline recloser locations. St. John's Main retains the filed Waterford River ductbank scope and the separately reported multi-year actual. Pooled program actuals are not used as asset-level commissioning evidence.

work_items.title: Add Newfoundland Power transformer repair durations
work_items.scope: Add the six transformer repair durations reported in NLH-NP-014 to the affected station histories.
work_items.notes: NLH-NP-014 physical PDF p. 1 records the repair type and days out of service for BLK-T2, DUN-T1, SLA-T3, HUM-T2, HUM-T3, and TRN-T1. The station records keep transformer repair time separate from customer interruption duration.

work_items.title: Add rural feeder reliability and capital program closeouts
work_items.scope: Add the published MIL-02 and PBD-01 reliability values and reconcile the related 2018 and 2021 capital programs without treating aggregate expenditure as asset commissioning evidence.
work_items.notes: CA-NP-034 physical PDF pp. 1 to 3 records 2016 to 2020 SAIDI and SAIFI for MIL-02 and PBD-01. The 2018 and 2022 expenditure reports close the combined capital programs with zero carryover. Neither report gives an asset-level commissioning date or as-built arrangement.

work_items.title: Find the latest supported Holyrood station arrangement
work_items.scope: Search for drawings later than the December 2012 demolition drawing and publish a separately dated arrangement.
work_items.notes: A July 2015 Holyrood field-investigation report reproduces drawing A0-1403-500-E-001 on physical PDF p. 17. Revision 19 is dated March 16, 2015 and states REVISED AS BUILT WITH NEW T4 EXTENSION. The drawing records the 230 kV, 138 kV, 66 kV, generating-unit, unit-service, station-service, gas-turbine, and black-start arrangements. Revision 18 added eight 1,825 kW mobile diesel units in October 2014. Revision 19 marks the 15 MW gas turbine no longer in service and notes that its 13.8 kV oil circuit breaker was removed and jumpered out. Later component records remain attached separately: the 2022 condition inventory, 2018 and 2019 39L equipment dates, the 2019 SST34 and auxiliary-supply completions, the 2024 T7 commissioning, the 2025 Unit 1 overhaul, and the 2026 Unit 3 operating record. No later complete published whole-plant one-line has been located.

work_items.title: Add Holyrood Unit 3 post-conversion as-built documentation
work_items.scope: Add the commissioned synchronous-condensing arrangement and operating data.
work_items.blocker: The available public evidence places permanent conversion in the spring 2030 planning case. No completed as-built conversion record has been located.
work_items.notes: The reversible starting arrangement is now documented from the 2011 capital filing: induction pony motor, speed-increasing gearbox, variable-fluid drive, SSS clutch, generator field application, and breaker closing at synchronous speed. Hydro's 2012 year-end capital table records $925,800 of total expenditure and no carryover into 2013 for the Unit 3 synchronous-condenser upgrade. A later equipment history explicitly records a new thrust bearing installed in 2012 for synchronous-condenser operation. These records describe the reversible operating arrangement and the 2012 bearing work, not the future permanent conversion. The June 2026 condition study says Hydro was assessing the continued requirement and effectiveness of Unit 3 synchronous-condensing capability. CA-NLH-058, filed September 18, 2026, again calls post-steam Unit 3 operation a planning assumption pending the RRA Study Review. No completed permanent conversion or as-built record has been located. Continue monitoring planning, construction, and commissioning filings.

work_items.title: Add the Avalon combustion turbine final connection
work_items.scope: Find issued-for-construction or as-built one-lines for the new terminal, GSU transformers, TL218 tie-in, synchronous-condenser equipment, and rerouted Newfoundland Power lines.
work_items.notes: The proposed record now shows three 13.8 kV, 50 MW combustion-turbine units, three connected 13.8/230 kV GSUs, one spare 50/66.6/83.3 MVA GSU, individual generator breakers and 13.8 kV switchgear, and the separate 138 kV station-service supply from Holyrood Bus 8. The February 2026 update confirms procurement of four GSUs and one station-service transformer. PUB-NLH-011 places the new terminal approximately 0.5 km from Holyrood, treats that section as a bus extension, and retains TL218 for the remaining 37 km to Oxen Pond. The October 2026 update records the 38L and 39L relocations complete on July 31, 2026. The public Basis of Design identifies the October 2024 switchyard layout and operation single-line drawing numbers, but both drawings are redacted in full. Final connection work remains deferred until an issued-for-construction, commissioning, or as-built record exists.

work_items.title: Add the October 2026 Avalon CT early execution status
work_items.scope: Record completed line relocations, executed equipment agreements, approved early execution budget, forecast commercial operation date, and the unresolved full-project approval gate.
work_items.notes: The October 2026 filing reports that Newfoundland Power completed the 38L and 39L relocations on July 31, 2026. It records the GE and Hitachi agreements, a $95.411 million approved early execution budget, and a March 7, 2030 forecast commercial operation date. The full 2025 Build Application still awaited a Board order, so HRDGT2 remains proposed.

work_items.title: Document Soldiers Pond converter station and AC yard
work_items.scope: Create source-linked converter, electrode, transformer, filter, and AC-yard records at the level supported by public documents.
work_items.notes: The published record separates the AC yard, LCC poles, synchronous condensers, converter-transformer spare, and electrode line. The filed 2015 breaker arrangement is implemented under ISL-029. Converter-transformer nameplates and station-service detail remain documented research targets rather than reconstructed data.

work_items.title: Document the Labrador-Island Link and Maritime Link
work_items.scope: Add dated system diagrams, ratings, terminals, electrodes, interfaces, and documented operating changes for both HVDC links.
work_items.notes: The system diagrams separate commissioned operation from earlier filed design material. Current as-built breaker arrangements and converter-transformer nameplate ratings remain open evidence targets rather than reconstructed data.

work_items.title: Resolve the Soldiers Pond transformer count and construction chronology
work_items.scope: Use construction and inquiry records to establish the converter-transformer count and dated AC-yard milestones without applying preliminary study ratings to installed equipment.
work_items.notes: Nalcor's September 2018 presentation records seven converter transformers transported to Soldiers Pond in spring 2017. The CD0504 civil scope separately lists six delta-star converter-transformer foundations and one spare foundation for the converter-station works. The independent engineer records the AC switchyard energized and fully commissioned in November 2017, with the converter transformers oil-filled on their pads. No located source gives installed converter-transformer voltage, impedance, winding, or MVA nameplate data.

work_items.title: Document the Corner Brook frequency converter and Deer Lake connection
work_items.scope: Create a dedicated record and diagram for the frequency-conversion interface shown in the island system filings.
work_items.notes: The record shows the 2005 filed operating arrangement, 2017 condition and upgrade evidence, and the 2018 sale and abandonment approval. Current post-sale operation remains an open evidence target.

work_items.title: Complete the historical VHF and microwave engineering record
work_items.scope: Index documented routes, sites, frequencies, radio models, antenna systems, ownership, and interconnection changes.
work_items.notes: The record now separates the 2001 conventional system, the proposed 2004 trunked replacement, and the radio and vehicle-data project reported in 2026. It includes the filed site registers, Hydro-owned frequency rows, microwave interconnection changes, replacement economics, and unresolved equipment-detail limits.

work_items.title: Reconstruct dated telecommunications network diagrams
work_items.scope: Create separate diagrams for the conventional VHF system, proposed trunked replacement, and later P25 and satellite-data arrangement.
work_items.notes: The three dated diagrams are separate. The 2004 diagram is labelled proposed, and the later diagram shows only the P25, Starlink, and Cradlepoint relationships stated by the filing. It does not infer P25 site topology or the provenance of surplus amateur-radio repeaters.

work_items.title: Expand measured load and planning comparisons
work_items.scope: Add dated station, feeder, interruption, transformer, and forecast records where actual and planning values can be compared without mixing data classes.
work_items.notes: The load record now separates the 2013/2014 Newfoundland Power and Avalon actual winter peaks, the January 2020 Nostradamus import failure, 2024 measured and forecast summaries, and the highest 2026 transformer planning ratios. King's Bridge and Ridge Road values are correctly labelled as five-year forecasts. Unpublished rural measurements remain deferred.

work_items.title: Add the Great Northern Peninsula historical peak and forecast record
work_items.scope: Extract the IC-270 Bear Cove and Plum Point monthly peak series, publish only complete-year maxima, and compare the recorded January to April 2001 peaks with the filed winter forecasts.
work_items.notes: IC-270 physical PDF pp. 5 to 7 contain 112 monthly rows. Bear Cove's recorded January to April 2001 peak was 5,801 kW against a 5,002 kW winter forecast. Plum Point's was 3,184 kW against 4,404 kW. Complete-year maxima exclude any year with a missing monthly kW value.

work_items.title: Add the current Great Northern Peninsula reliability and Hawke's Bay backup record
work_items.scope: Preserve the 2021 to 2025 regional reliability indices, outage causes, system extent, line design loads, Hawke's Bay diesel capacity, and documented restoration role.
work_items.notes: Hydro's March 31, 2026 reply provides five-year SAIDI and SAIFI values, outage-cause shares, 16 terminal stations, about 700 km of transmission line, 13 communities, and regional design loads. The Hawke's Bay record combines the current 5 MW backup role with the two filed 2.5 MW units, 2024 transformer records, the 2011 restoration sequence, and the 2026 life-extension assessment.

work_items.title: Add the January 2026 Bay d'Espoir frazil-ice event
work_items.scope: Preserve the generating-unit shutdown, reserve levels, synchronous-condenser operation and observed return-to-service sequence from Hydro's event report.
work_items.notes: The event record retains the January 21 removal of all seven units and approximately 250 MW reserve, the January 24 Power Warning at approximately 360 MW reserve, the January 25 release of Units 1 to 6 at 6 x 76.5 MW, and the January 31 release of Unit 7 at 154.4 MW.

work_items.title: Build a sourced coordinate and route dataset
work_items.scope: Extract defensible station coordinates and line routes from utility maps, drawings, GIS records, or other public primary sources.
work_items.notes: The dataset contains 588 historical GeoAtlas route features, the one island-intersecting GeoAtlas TL_ID 3501 feature, and 22 checked station-boundary centroids. The Avalon coordinate set includes five terminal stations and 17 Newfoundland Power substations with unambiguous published OpenStreetMap boundaries. The historical route layer has validation years from 1979 through 1991 and no utility circuit designations. GeoAtlas layer 15 has no voltage field and no separate L3502 geometry. Unsupported rural records and current AC circuit-to-route matching are deferred.

work_items.title: Create the geographic island and Avalon map interface
work_items.scope: Overlay the structured network on a defensible geographic base while preserving source-map access and voltage distinctions.
work_items.notes: The interface renders the historical GeoAtlas routes, the published TL_ID 3501 route, and 22 checked station coordinates at island and Avalon scales. Every mapped Avalon station opens its terminal or substation record. Station selection updates the detail panel without moving the page. Unsupported rural station coverage and current AC circuit-to-route matching are deferred.

work_items.title: Configure the GitHub repository
work_items.scope: Create or connect the GitHub remote, choose repository visibility, and push the reviewed history.
work_items.notes: The public GitHub repository is connected as origin and the local main branch tracks origin/main.

work_items.title: Define the public evidence-package strategy
work_items.scope: Define which source PDFs are committed, which remain external, and how the multi-gigabyte mirrors can be restored without depending on the live PUB site.
work_items.notes: The repository carries 66 pinned PDFs with a machine-checked digest manifest. The three large mirrors remain outside Git. Their local counts and control-file hashes are recorded, and the restore design uses immutable content-addressed objects plus path indexes. Publishing those external objects is tracked separately in REL-005.

work_items.title: Publish the static atlas
work_items.scope: Publish the clean production build to GitHub Pages or the approved static host.
work_items.notes: GitHub Pages is live. The workflow passed, assets loaded under the repository base path, the MUN-08 interaction worked, the 390 by 844 px layout had no page overflow, and the browser reported no warnings or errors.

work_items.title: Run the clean-clone release qualification
work_items.scope: Verify source hashes, tests, build, links, accessibility, responsive layouts, and repository cleanliness from a clean clone.
work_items.notes: A fresh public clone at af61cb5 passed 71 tests, the production build, hashes for 66 pinned PDFs, and a clean-worktree check. Rerun this gate for each release candidate.

work_items.title: Publish the external archive snapshot
work_items.scope: Select public object storage, publish the content-addressed PUB, NL Hydro, and Newfoundland Power mirror objects and path indexes, then prove a clean restore without contacting the source sites.
work_items.notes: Deferred by the user on 2026-11-12. Do not put the raw mirrors in the Git repository. When publication resumes, a restore passes only when all objects verify and the restored audit counts match research/external-archive-manifest.json.
